title: Hydrogen-producing communities from a CSTR-type digester fed with tequila vinasses.
description: Biological data (C19, C23, and C27) from a high throughput Illumina MiSeq service to characterize abundance, diversity, and population dynamics of hydrogen-producing communities present in a CSTR-type digester fed with tequila vinasses. The aim of this study was analyze the microbial interactions during the hydrogen production via dark fermentation.
samples: CSTR-type digester fed with tequila vinasses.
